product_summary: Website sunandafoods.com (Gujarat, Plot No.15, Vibrant Eureka Industrial Park, Kadodara, Gandhinagar, Gujarat-382305) lists a very broad catalogue: (1) Whole spices — clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, black pepper, dry red chilli, turmeric finger, dry ginger, cumin seed, cardamom, coriander seed, white pepper; (2) Powders & blended spices — chilli powder, chilli flakes, ginger powder, black/white pepper powder, cardamom powder, clove powder, nutmeg powder, cinnamon powder, garam masala, chicken masala, chole masala, cumin powder, curry powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder; (3) Dehydrated onion and garlic (whole + powder); (4) Pulses/dals — toor, moong, masoor, chana, urad, rajma, lobia; (5) Herbal — ashwagandha, shatavari, triphala, tulsi, brahmi; (6) Rice — basmati and non-basmati; (7) Other — guar gum, green millet, groundnuts, fruit/vegetable seeds, chickpeas, psyllium husk, chia seed, foxnut (makhana), basil seed, cattle feed; (8) Sugar & confectionery — sugar, sugar powder, patasa, sakariya, thread mishri, toffee, candy, chocolate, revdi, jaggery.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site claims own processing (cleaning/sorting, low-heat grinding, blending, packaging) at a Gujarat industrial-park unit, but the catalogue spans unrelated commodity groups (pulses, rice, guar gum, cattle feed, confectionery, herbal extracts) that a single spice grinder does not produce; typical of a spice processor that also trades agri-commodities. No customs line or GST record reviewed here, so the manufacturer claim is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: Declared HS 091099 (mixed condiments/seasonings, other) is only partially correct. It genuinely fits the blended masalas (garam masala, chicken masala, chole masala, curry powder) and is a defensible residual heading for some spice powders, but it does NOT cover the bulk of the declared business: whole/unprocessed spices fall in 0904–0910 (pepper 0904, cinnamon 0906.11/0906.19, clove 0906.20, cardamom 0908.31/0908.32, nutmeg 0908.22, cumin 0909.31, coriander 0909.21, turmeric 0910.30, ginger 0910.12, chilli 0904.21/0904.22); single-ingredient powders are excluded from 0910.99 by the heading text and go to their own lines (pepper powder 0904.12, chilli powder 0904.22, turmeric powder 0910.30, cumin powder 0909.32, coriander powder 0909.22, ginger powder 0910.12). Dehydrated onion/garlic belong to 0712.20/0712.31, pulses to 0713.xx, rice to 1006.xx, herbal products to 1211.90/1302, sugar to 1701/1702, confectionery to 1704.90/1806.xx, cattle feed to 2309.90, guar gum to 1302.32, psyllium husk to 1211.90/1302.39. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is broadly right but understates the agri-commodity/trading component (pulses, rice, guar gum, cattle feed) — this is a spice processor plus agri-commodity trader, not a pure FMCG brand. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: dehydrated vegetables, pulses, rice, herbal/botanical powders, sugar and confectionery, cattle feed, oilseeds/nuts. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to the actual multi-line range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data is from the company's own website catalogue only — no customs line was available in this task, so every product and the export claim ('we export quality spices to international markets') is marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. No PAN, CIN, revenue or shipment data researched per role scope; null.
